components: Six-stage pipeline: Transcribe, Pack, LLM Reasons, EDL, Render, Self-Eval
ElevenLabs Scribe word-level transcription (cached per source)
takes_packed.md: phrase-level transcript, the model's primary reading document
timeline_view: on-demand filmstrip + waveform PNG (the model looks only when it needs to)
edl.json: the cut list (source, in/out, beat label, quote, reasoning, grade, overlays, subtitles)
Parallel animation sub-agents: HyperFrames, Remotion, Manim, PIL
render.py + grade.py (ASC CDL per channel); ffmpeg; subtitles applied LAST
project.md: session memory appended per edit

commands.text: edit these into a launch video

outputs.text: [002.52-005.36] S0 Ninety percent of what a web agent does is completely wasted.

architecture_facts: The model never watches the video. It reasons over a packed text transcript plus a few on-demand PNGs.
Audio is primary: cuts snap to word boundaries from a word-level transcript, and it never cuts inside a word.
It spawns parallel sub-agents to build overlay animations in HyperFrames, Remotion, Manim, or PIL.
Before you ever see the cut, it self-evaluates every boundary, then re-renders, up to three passes.
Transcribe, Pack, LLM Reasons, EDL, Render, Self-Eval are the six named stages of the loop.
Session memory persists to project.md so later edits re-plan without re-transcribing.
surprising_detail: The model never sees a single frame while it edits. It reads the transcript as text and only pulls a filmstrip PNG when it needs to actually look. Naive frame-reading would be tens of millions of tokens of noise.

diagram_node_facts.Transcribe: ElevenLabs Scribe pulls a word-level transcript, cached per source.
diagram_node_facts.Pack: Phrases fold into takes_packed.md, the model's primary reading document.
diagram_node_facts.Reason: The model reasons over text and on-demand PNGs, never the raw frames.
diagram_node_facts.EDL: Decisions land in edl.json: source, in and out, beat, quote, reasoning.
diagram_node_facts.Render: render.py extracts per segment, concatenates, then burns subtitles last.
diagram_node_facts.Self-Eval: It inspects every cut boundary and re-renders, up to three passes.
